liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Cassidy** (2 reviews): The first set gains momentum with Cassidy, before Don't Ease Me In winds it down; Cassidy is rated very good, after Friend of the Devil picks things up [15][16]
- **The Red Rooster** (1 review): Reviewer finds the Rooster slippery and elusive, compact and flowing easily [11]
- **Friend of the Devil** (1 review): Brent's progressive synth sounds distract from the folk feel of this song [11]
- **Victim or the Crime** (1 review): The Victim, Scarlet, Fire run in the second set is singled out as a highlight [10]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Scarlet into Fire has no transition jam, and Jerry seems uninterested [15]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Brent rocks hard after space, making The Other One crunchy and weird [16]
- **Uncle John's Band** (1 review): Uncle John's Band late in the second set is called a nice touch [14]

## Setlist highlights

- **The Red Rooster**: back after 190 archived shows (914 days); rare: 12 archived performances [21]
- **Queen Jane Approximately**: cut on the recording [21]
- **Space**: cut on the recording [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1988-10-01.beyerM88.russjcan.94478.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 19 songs; 140 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1988-10-01.142489.sbd.bm.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 18 songs; 145 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd88-10-01.sbd.sacks.7728.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 138 min; rated 3/5 by 12 [3]. Said about its sound: Clean soundboard mix but missing low end; Phil's bass is underrepresented [12]
- **gd1988-10-01.ec7.s2.bowen.116400.flac**: source not stated; 11 songs; 77 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [8]

## Around the show

- Tapers were moved to reserved Section 202 directly behind the soundboard, which made taping more of a hassle [13]
- Reviewer sat in the first row behind the board both Saturday and Sunday, next to fellow taper TaprRon [13]
- Jerry's voice sounds noticeably more worn when the band returns for the second set [15]
- Attendee says Jerry's voice was in poor shape and the band sounded like they were working [18]
- Reviewer hears Garcia's singing and playing as weak, with the band seeming to rehearse onstage [19]
- In 1988 the tapers section moved to Section 202, reserved seating directly behind the soundboard [7]
- Judged better than the previous night's show, though Jerry still seems to struggle [16]
- The 1987 Shoreline tapes sounded punchier thanks to lawn repeater towers, which were lost in 1988 [7]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1988-10-01.beyerM88.russjcan.94478.flac16**: taped by Russ Cansler; transferred by Russ Cansler; source: Beyerdynamic M-88's XY60 with Sony WMD6-C Maxell MX 90 No nr Offical taping section front of lawn 140 feet away,dead center Mic stand at 7 feet [1]
- **gd1988-10-01.142489.sbd.bm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Beta HiFi Master (Sony Betamax/TDK HS) [2]. Also: Healy soundboard mix with no ambient mics, remastered from Darren Sacks's patch source; 16-bit, 44.1 kHz [2]
- **gd88-10-01.sbd.sacks.7728.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> Cass> DAT> CDR> EAC> SHN (seekable) [3]. Also: Soundboard to cassette, DAT, CDR, then EAC to seekable SHN, via Darrin Sacks [3]
- **gd1988-10-01.ec7.s2.bowen.116400.flac**: taped by Jeff Bowen; transferred by Jeff Bowen; source: Set 2 Only Source: (OTS) Superscope EC-7's > Marantz PMD-430; [8]
